name: new-features
description: The same five personas on four tasks for what landed after the first runs: context that fits a token budget, time buckets, a key for one table, and rollups.

personas.name: Maya Chen
personas.role: a backend developer who has used PostgreSQL every day for eight years
personas.background: Maya is trying ChloeDB for a new service and judges it against Postgres.
traits: Writes SQL fluently and reaches for Postgres habits first (SERIAL, ILIKE, NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days', \d to describe a table).
Reads error messages carefully and expects them to say what to change.
Opens the documentation after two failed attempts, not before.
Patient for about fifteen minutes, then decides the product is not ready.

personas.name: Tomás Rivera
personas.role: a data analyst who writes reporting SQL
personas.background: Tomás builds weekly reports. He has never used a search engine's query language.
traits: Comfortable with SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY and dates; has never heard of BM25 or full-text ranking.
Likes to look at a table's columns and a few rows before writing a query.
Copies examples from documentation when he finds one.
Gives up after about five failed attempts and says what blocked him.

personas.name: Priya Nair
personas.role: a machine learning engineer building retrieval for a chatbot
personas.background: Priya wants to know quickly whether ChloeDB can be her retrieval layer.
traits: Thinks in embeddings, vector search and hybrid ranking; knows BM25 by name.
Skims text and jumps to whatever looks like an API or a query box.
Impatient with forms and wizards; prefers typing a query.
Will judge the whole product on the first thing that confuses her.

personas.name: Jordan Okafor
personas.role: the on-call site reliability engineer for the team's databases
personas.background: Jordan looks after production access and incidents.
traits: Looks for admin, access and settings pages first.
Cares about least privilege: read-only means read-only, keys should expire.
Reads labels literally and distrusts anything ambiguous about permissions.
Efficient: does not explore beyond what the task needs.

personas.name: Sam Lee
personas.role: a product manager who does not write SQL
personas.background: Sam checks things on a phone between meetings and wants answers, not queries.
traits: Does not write SQL; will copy and edit an example if one is in front of them.
Relies on labels, menus and search boxes; jargon (shards, segments, BM25) confuses Sam.
Uses a phone, so wide tables and small buttons are a problem.
Gives up after three or four dead ends and says why.

tasks.title: Context for a support bot
tasks.prompt: We're building a support bot. From the tickets table, pull the tickets about people who can't get into their account, with as much of their text as fits in about 250 tokens, so I can paste it into the bot's prompt. Give me that text, and tell me which ticket ids are in it.

tables.name: tickets
tables.create: CREATE TABLE tickets (id KEYWORD PRIMARY KEY, subject TEXT, body TEXT, product KEYWORD, created TIMESTAMP)

rows.subject: Invoice shows wrong VAT
rows.body: The March invoice charged 21% VAT but we are registered in Ireland, should be 23%.

rows.subject: Export to CSV times out
rows.body: Exporting the contacts list with 40k rows times out after a minute in the web dashboard.

rows.subject: Can't sign in on the iPhone app
rows.body: Since the update the iOS app says 'session expired' right after I enter my password. Web login works fine.

rows.subject: Dark mode colors unreadable
rows.body: Grey text on the dark background in the reports page is almost invisible.

rows.subject: Webhook retries flood our endpoint
rows.body: When our server returns 500 your webhooks retry every second for an hour.

rows.subject: Add SSO with Okta
rows.body: We need SAML SSO with Okta before we can roll this out to 300 people.

rows.subject: Duplicate charges this month
rows.body: We were billed twice for the Team plan on October 1st. Please refund one.

rows.subject: Android app stuck in a login loop
rows.body: After entering my email and code the Android app sends me back to the sign-in screen, again and again.

rows.subject: API rate limit too low
rows.body: 429 errors at 50 requests per second; our plan says 100.

rows.subject: Push notifications arrive late
rows.body: Notifications on my phone show up 20 minutes after the event.

rows.subject: Refund never arrived
rows.body: You confirmed a refund of $49 on September 20th but nothing reached my card after three weeks.

rows.subject: Search ignores accents
rows.body: Searching for 'jose' does not find 'José' in contacts.

rows.subject: Calendar sync drops events
rows.body: Recurring events from Google Calendar disappear after the first week.

rows.subject: Two-factor code never comes on mobile
rows.body: On the phone app the 2FA text message never arrives, so I cannot get into my account from my phone. On desktop it works.

rows.subject: Price increase not announced
rows.body: Our renewal went from $12 to $15 per seat without any email.

rows.subject: SDK throws on null fields
rows.body: The Python SDK raises KeyError when a contact has no phone number.

rows.subject: Offline mode loses edits
rows.body: Edits made on the tablet while offline vanish when it reconnects.

rows.subject: Cannot delete my account
rows.body: The delete account button in settings does nothing.

rows.subject: Locked out of the mobile app after password change
rows.body: I changed my password on the website and now the mobile app won't accept the new one or the old one.

rows.subject: Bulk import skips rows
rows.body: Importing 2,000 contacts from Excel only created 1,640, no error shown.

rows.subject: Receipt PDF is blank
rows.body: The receipt for my last payment opens as an empty PDF.

rows.subject: Slow dashboard on Mondays
rows.body: The main dashboard takes 15 seconds to load every Monday morning.

rows.subject: Tablet layout cuts off buttons
rows.body: On the iPad the save button is hidden behind the keyboard.

rows.subject: Webhook signature mismatch
rows.body: The HMAC signature header doesn't match when the payload has emoji.

tasks.title: The busiest day
tasks.prompt: Our orders are in the table orders. Which single day had the most orders, and how many orders did it have? Days in UTC.

tables.name: orders
tables.create: CREATE TABLE orders (id KEYWORD PRIMARY KEY, status KEYWORD, total FLOAT, created_at TIMESTAMP)

checks.name: the busiest day's count
checks.sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY d ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.title: A key for one table
tasks.prompt: Our BI tool, Metabase, needs a key that can read the orders table and nothing else: it must not see the customers table. Make that key in the command center, name it metabase, and tell me what to paste into Metabase.

tables.name: orders
tables.create: CREATE TABLE orders (id KEYWORD PRIMARY KEY, status KEYWORD, total FLOAT, created_at TIMESTAMP)

tables.name: customers
tables.create: CREATE TABLE customers (id KEYWORD PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email KEYWORD, city KEYWORD)

checks.name: a metabase key that reads orders only

tasks.title: Daily counts kept up to date
tasks.prompt: Our dashboard counts orders by status for each day, straight from the orders table, every time it loads, and it is getting slow. Set ChloeDB up so those daily counts are kept up to date ahead of time, then show me yesterday's counts by status from what you set up.

tables.name: orders
tables.create: CREATE TABLE orders (id KEYWORD PRIMARY KEY, status KEYWORD, total FLOAT, created_at TIMESTAMP)
